what: DuPont makes specialty materials. After separating its electronics business it is focused on water filtration, protection materials such as Tyvek and Kevlar, and healthcare and industrial materials.
customers: Water utilities and industrial water users, construction and safety equipment makers, medical device companies and industrial manufacturers.
money: reverse osmosis membranes, Tyvek, Kevlar and Nomex
medical packaging, adhesives and industrial materials
moat: Branded materials such as Kevlar and Tyvek that are specified by name in safety standards and building codes, which makes substitution a regulatory question rather than a purchasing one.
risks: It reported a loss after separation and impairment charges
Revenue has fallen about 19% a year over three years as businesses were spun off
Return on invested capital of about 1% after the restructuring
Construction and industrial demand has been soft
opportunities: Analysts see about 14% upside from current levels
Water filtration demand grows with scarcity and tightening contaminant rules
A simpler company after the electronics separation, with less debt
watch: Organic revenue growth in Water and Protection and operating margin.
